name: Nauru Visa (all visitors)
summary: Visas are requested by email to Nauru Immigration. You send a form, a passport scan and a letter from your employer saying why you are going. The site doesn't say who is exempt, fees or stay length.

other: Who needs a visa, durations and general fees are not stated on the page read. Check with Nauru Immigration.

documents: Letter from employer stating the reason for the trip

name: Media Visa
summary: Visiting journalists and media crews apply by email. The fee is high and not refunded if you are refused.

other: Employer letter stating the reason for the trip.

steps: Email Nauru Immigration with your request to enter.
Send the form, passport scan and employer letter.
Airport immigration holds your passport on arrival and returns it later that day or the next morning.
